detailed_description: The Funnel Chart Generator builds an ECharts funnel chart from editable stage and value rows. You can load sample funnel data, add or delete stages, view simple conversion rates between rows, set the chart title, choose a color theme, change sort order and funnel alignment, toggle legend and labels, and preview the chart in the browser. Finished charts can be downloaded as PNG or SVG images.
usage_steps: Start with the default rows or click Load Sample to use the sample conversion funnel.
Edit each stage name and numeric value in the data table, or add and delete rows as needed.
Adjust the chart title, color theme, sort order, funnel alignment, legend, and label settings.
Preview the funnel chart and download it as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Create a simple awareness-to-purchase funnel from manually entered stage values.
Compare lead, qualified lead, proposal, and closed deal counts in a sales pipeline chart.
Sketch a product onboarding funnel and check the displayed conversion rate between steps.
Download a manually prepared funnel chart as SVG for a report or slide deck.

faqs.question: What is a funnel chart used for?
faqs.answer: A funnel chart visualizes sequential stages in a linear process (such as a sales pipeline, marketing conversion flow, or customer onboarding funnel), highlighting conversion and drop-off rates at each step.

faqs.question: Can I sort the funnel in ascending or descending order?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can toggle sorting between descending (standard funnel), ascending (inverse pyramid), or custom data order.

faqs.question: Which export formats are supported?
faqs.answer: You can export your completed funnel visualization directly as a high-resolution PNG image or scalable vector SVG.
